title: The Blue Notebook Review - October 19 through October 25th
description:
This week’s Blue Notebook Review with Sgt. Verbeck takes a look at crime trends from October 19 through October 25— including key arrests, investigations, and cases that shaped the week.

Sgt. Verbeck also shares footage from this week’s Press Conference where SMPD Interim Chief Darrick Jacob, alongside District Attorney Nathan Hochman, announced the arrest and filing of charges in the fatal Wilshire Boulevard hit-and-run case.

We close with a tribute to our beloved Mounted Unit partner, Laredo — whose service, spirit, and connection to this community will never be forgotten. 💙🐴
